youtube_title: Sell Winners, Keep Losers? Your Brain's Trap 🧠 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Up 10%? Sold. Down 30%? 'Wapas aayega.' Sound familiar?

This is the DISPOSITION EFFECT. A classic study of 10,000 trading accounts (Odean, 1998) found investors sold winners about 60% more often than losers (14.8% vs 9.8% of gains/losses realised). Worse: the winners they sold went on to beat the losers they kept by about 3.4% over the next year.

Rule: write your exit BEFORE you buy. Sell when your reason breaks, not when you 'feel OK'.
Moral: Cut your losers, let your winners run.

Source: Odean (1998), Journal of Finance.
Education only, not investment advice.
